scATAC QC measured 3000 cells and 40057 peaks.
scATAC preprocessing completed (cohort matrix union): the resulting matrix has 3000 cell(s) x 40057 peak(s).
scATAC regulatory-layer analysis ran 1 of 5 optional layer(s); skipped layers are reported with their prerequisites.
